location_rules.remote_first: allowed if open to candidates based in the UK or Europe
location_rules.europe_office: allowed if the role is based in a European office AND the company offers relocation support or visa sponsorship, or plausibly hires from the UK. If the listing doesn't say, flag it for human confirmation - never assume either way, and never silently drop it.
location_rules.why: The candidate is UK-based and open to relocating within Europe, so the deciding question is whether they can work in the role's location. The search focuses on remote and relocation-friendly roles because boards built for them (relocate.me, Wellfound, Himalayas) state location eligibility clearly and are practical for an agent to search, unlike LinkedIn or Indeed.

compensation_floor.rule: include if unstated; include if above floor; exclude only if a stated figure is clearly and substantially below it
compensation_floor.note: Left blank in the committed version - this is a real negotiating position, not something to publish. Set your own numbers in a local, uncommitted edit.

notes_for_editing: This file is the whole point of extending the agent without touching code. Add/remove sources, adjust the comp floor, or add new role titles here.
